title: A new criterion for the normalized Haar measure to be a Pietsch measure
summary: In this paper we present a new criterion to determine when the normalized Haar measure on a compact topological group is a Pietsch measure for nonlinear summing mappings. As a consequence, we provide a partial answer to a problem raised by Botelho et al. in \cite{haar botelho} motivated by a question posed to the authors by J. Diestel. It is explicitly shown that this criterion encompasses recent and new results as particular cases.
